units.source_text: 我没听明白“都被吃掉啦”是什么意思。

en.t: I did not understand what “they were all eaten” meant.

units.source_text: 戴着夹鼻眼镜的查喀医生大概觉察到我不明就里，就在一旁补充：

en.t: Doctor Chack, wearing pince-nez glasses, apparently realized that I did not understand and added from the side:

units.source_text: “将这些河童职工都杀了，肉就当做食品了。

en.t: “If these kappa workers are all killed, their meat becomes food.
Please look closely at this newspaper.

units.source_text: 这个月正好解雇了六万四千七百六十九只，肉价也就跟着大幅度下跌了。”

en.t: This month exactly 64,769 were dismissed, so the price of meat fell sharply along with it.”
